name: Set TCP Auto-Tuning Level
description: Applies a selected TCP receive window auto-tuning level for the Windows TCP stack.

description_i18n.en: Applies a selected TCP receive window auto-tuning level for the Windows TCP stack.
description_i18n.de: Legt für den Windows-TCP-Stack die automatische Anpassung des TCP-Empfangsfensters auf Normal, Eingeschränkt oder Deaktiviert fest.
description_i18n.fr: Règle l'ajustement automatique de la fenêtre de réception TCP de Windows sur Normal, Restreint ou Désactivé.

warnings.message: Administrator privileges required: This tweak requires an elevated administrator session to apply changes.
Advanced tweak: This tweak targets advanced system behavior and should be changed with care.

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: Uses netsh interface tcp set global autotuninglevel to apply the selected receive-window auto-tuning level. Restore returns the level to normal.
